text:
alex: Quick sync: follow-up on intake -> bench mapping. I want a minimal, auditable smoke harness contract so we can unblock models quickly without running full deep benches. Thoughts?
alex: Problem: teams upload heavy models and expect fast signoff. Bench runs take hours; we need a cheap canonical smoke that hits keyslices and runtime paths.
sara: Agree. Proposal: two-tier bench types in descriptor: `smoke_profile` and `deep_profile`. Smoke runs are small (token-hours cap) and must exercise KV cache, attention kernels, and tokenizer roundtrip.
ravi: We should make `smoke_profile` mandatory for admission. It can be auto-generated if missing but must be visible in catalog.
jia: What about seqlen coverage? Smoke should include 3 buckets: short, mid, long. Not exact weights but representative counts, e.g., 20/5/2 runs.
aleo: typo — leo here: also include a `warmup_iters` param to ensure kernels JIT/warm paths are exercised (some regressions only show after warmup).
sara: Good call. Add `warmup_iters` default 32. Also `smoke_timeout` to avoid hung runs.
leo: UX: when smoke fails, intake should return a compact failure summary: failing stage, stderr tails, and a one-click re-run link to console. No huge logs in chat.
ingest-bot: [automated] rule: if smoke_profile missing -> auto-generate draft and set `review_required=false` for low-risk models.
ravi: Auto-generate draft is fine but we need provenance: who created it and what inputs. Add `smoke_generated_by` + `smoke_generated_at`.
jia: For rollouts, we need to attach `canary_tag` in descriptor so routing can send small % of traffic to the canary variant during admission experiments. Example: `canary_tag: "ingest-canary-2026-03"`.
sara: We already have canary thoughts elsewhere; but include `canary_percent` default 0 until promoted. Intake will flip to 1% when bench smoke passes.
leo: Safety: add `rollback_on_perf_regression=true` as a default to ensure automated routing falls back on SLA or latencies exceed thresholds. Also need a `perf_slo_ms` field for the model descriptor.
alex: Nice. Now compatibility checks: beyond quant_abi_version, I want `abi_compat_matrix` listing supported runtime versions with pass/fail tags, so intake can pre-screen for known bad combos.
ravi: Instead of enumerating versions, make it `min_runtime_version` and `unsupported_runtime_tags` list. Maintains smaller descriptors.
alia: (typo) jia: We also need an `admit_check_results` blob that the admit service writes after validation: pass/fail, score, and compact notes. Keep it small and short-lived but persisted in catalog.
sara: Important: catalog entries must be immutable snapshots. When descriptor changes, previous admit_check_results must be retained for historical repro. Add `descriptor_version` (semver-ish).
leo: Operationally, bench workers should fetch `smoke_profile` and `descriptor_version` to ensure they ran against the correct manifest.
alex: Rollout plan: 1) Week 0: require smoke_profile on new descriptors (auto-gen allowed). 2) Week 2: start tagging canary_percent=1 for passing models. 3) Week 6: require smoke_profile for all existing models (backfill via auto-gen).
ravi: For metrics: smoke must report `smoke_latency_ms_p50/p95` and `smoke_token_rate`. Bench should surface small diffs over baseline and block if p95 > baseline * 1.5 or token_rate < baseline * 0.7.
jia: Baselines: compute per-model baseline from historical canonical runs; if none exist use model-family defaults. Document fallback.
leo: Edgecases: multi-file tokenizers or external vocab endpoints. Intake should validate `tokenizer_fingerprint` for multi-file bundles and reject if mismatch.
ingest-bot: [automated] check: model alex/bayeux:2026-03 - smoke_profile missing -> DRAFT_CREATED (/catalog/drafts/alex-bayeux-2026-03).
sar a: small nit: please do not leak internal path names in public errors; map to short tokens in user-facing messages.
alex: Action items:
- alex: draft smoke_profile schema + examples by Friday.
- ravi + leo: implement auto-gen + provenance stamp flow.
- jia: define baseline computation rules and SLO gating thresholds.
- sara: UX error messaging and one-click re-run design.
- ingest-bot: persist draft link in fail messages.
ravi: I'll review schema and own rollout plan. I can also prototype the auto-gen quick-scan.
leo: I'll take the console re-run flow.
alex: thanks all. Quick thumbs if you're on board.
sara: :thumbsup:
ravi: :thumbsup:
jia: :thumbsup:
leo: :thumbsup:
